rules.statement: Deeds conveying undivided shares in land without clear boundaries create only undivided interests, not specific allotments.
rules.supporting_quote: "Applying the test of precision which appears to me to be called for in such cases, I have taken the view that Rajapakse by the deeds 1 D 1 and P4 conveyed to his two children only undivided shares in the proportions of 2/3to 1/3 respectively."
